verdict.rationale: PayPal's own agent toolkit exposes dispute tools: list_disputes, get_dispute and accept_dispute_claim, which resolves a dispute in favor of the buyer. Its REST API portal also lists a disputes API, so developers can retrieve dispute status and accept claims programmatically. However, nothing documents submitting evidence or contesting a chargeback, and nothing ties disputes to agent-originated transactions (e.g., Braintree Agent Ready/ACP/UCP payments). Missing for 10: documented evidence-submission/contest endpoint, outcome/resolution tracking beyond accepting a claim, explicit dispute handling for Braintree-processed agent transactions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, disputes and chargebacks on agent transactions can be handled via API — evidence submission, status, outcomes
